message:
classes take their template from the decorator, not a file:
      libs/components/widget/src/badge.ts: PctWidgetBadge
$reason: The template under a name written with a Unicode escape, `t\u0065mplate:`, its text kept in a constant. The parser holds the name's text, `template`, and so does ngc, which compiles the constant into `consts` (measured through ngc in partial mode and the linker; the class in `package.json` carries the declaration ngc writes). The pattern that stood at point 1 read the name as written and saw no template, the counter over the decorator's body had nothing to count, and point 2 named the class as one the scanner does not see; a read of the name as written (`getText()`) would again.
